title: Iridium pushes on with satellite NB-IoT plans, targets 2026 launch
summary: Iridium, an established LEO satellite operator, is advancing its plans to launch satellite NB-IoT services in 2026. This follows its 2024 decision to adopt 3GPP standards for Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) after a shift in market dynamics and Qualcomm's pivot away from proprietary solutions. Iridium aims to leverage its existing global satellite fleet for both IoT and consumer device connectivity, including emergency messaging, while expressing skepticism about the ambitious revenue projections of newer D-2-D broadband players.

title: New Philips Norelco Shaver i9000 Prestige Ultra Introduces the Brand's First "Root-Level" Shave, for Closest Shave Yet
summary: Philips Norelco has launched its most advanced electric shaver, the Norelco Shaver i9000 Prestige Ultra, featuring AI-powered "root-level" shave technology that cuts hair up to -0.08mm below the surface. Key features include SenseIQ Pro technology with live coaching, five smart shaving modes, a 360° Precision Flexing System, and 72 self-sharpening NanoTech Dual Precision blades. Priced between $329.99-$499.99, the shaver also comes with a 7-year warranty upon registration, addressing consumer needs for precision, comfort, and longevity.

title: More than 1.8 Million SharkNinja Foodi Multi-Cookers Recalled Due to Burn Risk
summary: SharkNinja has recalled over 1.8 million Foodi OP300 Series multi-cookers in the U.S. and Canada due to a burn risk. The pressure-cooking lid can be opened during use, allowing hot contents to escape, leading to 106 reported burn injuries, including over 50 second- or third-degree burns. Consumers are advised to immediately stop using the pressure-cooking function and contact SharkNinja for a free replacement lid.

title: 5 elements of 'smart' hospital rooms
summary: Smart hospital rooms integrate digital health technologies like virtual tools, AI, and remote monitoring to enhance clinician workflow, patient experience, and care outcomes. Key elements include smart bedside tablets and TVs for virtual interaction, voice assistants for hands-free communication, remote patient monitoring tools, AI-enabled fall detection systems, and real-time location systems for improved efficiency and safety. These technologies aid in remote care, vital sign monitoring, fall prevention, and optimizing hospital operations.

title: O’Reilly Automotive, Inc. (ORLY): Among Charles Akre’s and John Neff’s Stock Picks With Huge Upside Potential
summary: This article highlights O’Reilly Automotive, Inc. (ORLY) as a key holding in Charles Akre’s and John Neff’s portfolios, emphasizing its significant upside potential. It discusses Akre Capital Management's investment philosophy, focusing on high-quality growth stocks, and details ORLY's strong market position, consistent sales growth, and future expansion plans, noting its 9th rank on a list of high-potential stock picks from Akre Capital.

title: Is FOLD’s Decline a Buying Opportunity?
summary: Amicus Therapeutics Inc. (FOLD) stock has declined by 12.63%, raising questions among investors and analysts about whether this presents a buying opportunity or signals deeper issues, especially with a legal investigation by Kaskela Law LLC underway. The company shows strong revenue growth and gross margins, but is burdened by significant losses and debt. While R&D investments offer future potential, current financial instability and legal scrutiny create uncertainty for the company's short-term outlook.

title: Expedia Group lays off employees in latest workforce cut
summary: Seattle-based Expedia Group conducted a new round of layoffs, impacting approximately 3% of its workforce, mainly in engineering and other departments. The company stated the restructuring is to strengthen its business and focus on strategic priorities for long-term growth. This follows multiple rounds of layoffs, despite reporting 10% revenue growth and 30% adjusted net income growth in the fourth quarter.

title: Amazon.com, Inc. 2025 Q1 - Results - Earnings Call Presentation (NASDAQ:AMZN) 2025-05-01
summary: This article provides the earnings call presentation from Amazon.com, Inc. for its Q1 2025 results. The company reported an EPS of $1.59, beating estimates by $0.23, and revenue of $155.67 billion, an 8.62% year-over-year increase, beating by $546.51 million. The article highlights that the slide deck was published in conjunction with their earnings call.

title: Chunghwa Telecom seeking further satellite deals – report
summary: Chunghwa Telecom is actively pursuing additional satellite partnerships to bolster its capacity and network resilience, engaging in discussions with Amazon's Project Kuiper and Canada's Telesat. This move follows previous agreements with OneWeb and Astranis, and comes as the Taiwanese telco aims to diversify international capacity after incidents involving offshore cables and faces delays in cable infrastructure projects. The company has ruled out a partnership with Starlink due to "regulatory restrictions" and security concerns related to Elon Musk's ties to China.

title: Apple, Amazon, Block, Take-Two, Dexcom, MicroStrategy, Duolingo, Roku, and More Movers
summary: Stocks continued to rally on Friday, influenced by robust U.S. jobs data and promising signs of impending trade negotiations between the U.S. and China. This positive momentum overshadowed mixed earnings reports from tech giants Apple and Amazon. The article lists several companies, including Block, Take-Two, Dexcom, MicroStrategy, Duolingo, and Roku, as significant movers in the market.

title: Lumen promises to bypass Equinix
summary: Lumen Technologies has launched a new "fabric" port offering designed to allow enterprise customers to connect to various digital services and cloud providers through a single port, aiming to bypass data center interconnect companies like Equinix. Lumen CEO Kate Johnson stated this disruptive service would eliminate the need for costly cross-connect fees. While some analysts view this as an innovative move to simplify cloud connections and reduce costs for enterprises, others caution that breaking into Equinix's established business model will be challenging given its broad reach, security benefits, and efficient multi-cloud access.

title: Extreme Networks’ New Channel Chief Is Veteran Of Cisco, Juniper Networks
summary: Extreme Networks has appointed Joe Spencer, a veteran with experience at Cisco, Juniper Networks, Amazon Web Services, and Zscaler, as its new senior vice president of global channel and strategic initiatives. Spencer will focus on building channel sales teams and driving growth through strategic alliances, partners, and distributors, implementing Extreme's go-to-market channel sales strategies. His appointment aims to redefine the channel chief role and leverage channel relationships more effectively, particularly as AI reshapes the networking industry.

title: Roku To Acquire Streaming Service Provider Frndly TV
summary: Roku, Inc. has announced its acquisition of Frndly TV, a subscription streaming service offering live TV and on-demand content, for $185 million in cash. This acquisition aims to boost Roku's platform revenue and subscriber base with an affordable live content offering. Frndly TV's team will remain, and the service will continue to be available across various platforms, with the deal expected to close in the second quarter.

title: Hasbro Pulse Star Wars Fanstream Event May 2nd Reveals
summary: Hasbro hosted a Star Wars Fanstream event on May 2nd, revealing new collectibles for The Black Series and The Vintage Collection lines, ahead of Star Wars Day. Pre-orders for most items begin on May 4th at 1 PM ET. The new products include a Force FX Elite Ezra Bridger Lightsaber, several Vintage Collection figure packs like Stormtroopers and Cantina Adventure, and Black Series figures such as Aayla Secura, Magnaguard, Shoretrooper & Death Trooper, Sandtrooper, and Clone Lieutenant Galle.

title: BlackRock, Inc. Reduces Stake in TTM Technologies Inc.
summary: BlackRock, Inc. has reduced its stake in TTM Technologies Inc. by 2,886,132 shares, a 15.77% decrease, though TTM Technologies still represents only 0.01% of BlackRock's portfolio. The transaction occurred at $20.51 per share, and despite the reduction and TTM Technologies being considered overvalued with a low GF Score, its stock price has increased by 22.04% since the transaction. First Eagle Investment Management, LLC remains TTM Technologies' largest holder, indicating continued investor interest.

title: BlackRock, Inc. Reduces Stake in The Interpublic Group of Compan
summary: BlackRock, Inc. significantly reduced its stake in The Interpublic Group of Companies Inc by selling over 5.6 million shares at $27.16 each. This transaction, part of BlackRock's portfolio management strategy, decreased its holding in IPG to 10.70% of its total shares in the company. IPG, a global advertising leader with a market cap of $9.38 billion, is considered modestly undervalued according to GF Value and recently entered a merger agreement with Omnicom.

title: Star Tribune - Earnings To Watch: L.B. Foster (FSTR) Reports Q1 Results Tomorrow
summary: L.B. Foster (NASDAQ: FSTR) is set to announce its Q1 earnings before market hours tomorrow. Analysts anticipate an 8% year-on-year revenue decline to $114.4 million and adjusted earnings of $0.03 per share, following a previous quarter where the company missed revenue, EBITDA, and EPS estimates. Despite past misses, analysts have reconfirmed their estimates, and the stock has seen positive sentiment in the general industrial machinery segment, with shares up 10.7% over the last month.

title: Hilton Negotiated Rates For Business & Leisure Travel 2025 Update
summary: This article provides an updated list of Hilton's negotiated corporate rates for 2025, catering to both business and leisure travelers. It highlights that Hilton, like other hospitality companies, offers discounts to employees of its largest accounts, accessible via specific business-specific pages without the need for complex corporate codes. The author advises users to only book eligible rates and review cancellation conditions, noting that some pages may require business email verification.

title: Results: Amazon.com, Inc. Beat Earnings Expectations And Analysts Now Have New Forecasts
summary: Amazon.com (NASDAQ: AMZN) recently reported its first-quarter results, beating analyst expectations for earnings per share, though revenues were in line with forecasts. Despite the strong performance, analysts have largely reconfirmed their previous outlook, with no major changes to revenue or EPS estimates for 2025, and the price target remains at US$240. The company's revenue growth is expected to slow but remain consistent with the broader industry.

title: Vita Coco Expands Coconut Juice Line Up with New Piña Colada Flavor
summary: Vita Coco has launched a new Piña Colada flavored coconut juice with pulp, timed for the summer season, aiming to provide a tropical escape. This new flavor joins their existing product line, offering a blend of pineapple and coconut water, and is available nationwide and online. The company emphasizes its mission to provide healthy and great-tasting products.

title: What’s driving the roller-coaster ride for San Francisco’s Hims & Hers stock?
summary: Shares of Hims & Hers, a San Francisco telehealth company, have experienced significant volatility recently, surging after a strong earnings report before dipping due to a cautious Q2 outlook, and then rebounding. The company, known for direct-to-consumer health services, reported revenue exceeding $586 million and a profit of 20 cents per share. Despite the positive financial performance, the stock's future hinges on its ability to navigate challenges including leadership changes, CEO controversies, and criticism over its Super Bowl advertisement.

title: Rezolve Ai CEO interviewed by PYMNTS: Why AI-Driven Retail Could Finally Fix eCommerce’s 70% Cart Abandonment Problem
summary: Rezolve Ai CEO Daniel Wagner discussed with PYMNTS how AI-driven retail can solve eCommerce's 70% cart abandonment problem by replicating and enhancing the in-store personalized shopping experience. The company's "Brain Suite" uses AI to provide deep product expertise, empathy, and conversion focus, addressing the fundamental inability of current digital platforms to offer personalized discovery. Additionally, Rezolve Ai is launching a crypto-enabled wallet with Tether, offering zero transaction fees for merchants and 8% earnings on USDT for consumers, aiming to revolutionize payments.

title: The Resurgence of the Beauty Marketplace
summary: Beauty marketplaces are experiencing a resurgence, driven by Amazon's success in prestige beauty and the rise of TikTok Shop. Retailers like Ulta Beauty and Walmart are investing in these platforms to expand their reach, drive revenue, and offer a broader assortment of products, despite past failures in the sector. The key to success lies in competitive pricing, strong customer loyalty, and a comprehensive product selection.

title: Weak US On-Highway Truck Demand Drags on Q1 Cummins Revenue
summary: Cummins reported a 3% decrease in Q1 2025 revenue, totaling $8.17 billion, largely due to weakening on-highway truck sales in North and South America and general economic uncertainty. The company declined to provide forward-looking guidance for the rest of 2025, citing unpredictable impacts from trade tariffs and emissions regulations. While most divisions saw declines, the power systems division experienced a 19% revenue increase driven by demand from data centers.

title: Earnings call transcript: Viant Technology Q1 2025 earnings beat expectations
summary: Viant Technology Inc. (DSP) reported a significant beat in its Q1 2025 earnings, with an EPS of $0.03 against a forecasted loss of $0.07 and revenue of $70.6 million, far exceeding expectations. The company saw a 32% year-over-year revenue increase and a 76% increase in adjusted EBITDA, driven by strong performance in connected TV (CTV) advertising and AI solutions. Viant's stock rose 4.96% in aftermarket trading, reflecting investor confidence and an outlook for continued growth, despite minor macroeconomic uncertainties causing some Q2 campaign activations to shift to the second half of 2025.

title: Inside Estée Lauder CEO Stéphane de La Faverie’s Fast-paced Reset of the Prestige Beauty Giant
summary: Estée Lauder's CEO, Stéphane de La Faverie, is spearheading a rapid and transformative overhaul of the prestige beauty giant, aiming to restore growth and profitability. His strategy, dubbed "Beauty Reimagined," focuses on organizational restructuring, increasing innovation, expanding distribution, and boosting efficiency by breaking down bureaucratic barriers. This ambitious plan comes during a challenging period for the company, marked by declines in the Chinese and travel-retail markets, but de La Faverie is committed to long-term structural and cultural changes.

title: IonQ Announces First Quarter Financial Results
summary: IonQ announced its first-quarter 2025 financial results, reporting revenue of $7.6 million and cash, cash equivalents, and investments totaling $697.1 million. The company highlighted significant commercial and technical advancements, including a $22 million deal with EPB to establish a quantum computing and networking hub, the pending acquisition of Lightsynq Technologies to accelerate quantum internet and computing roadmaps, and the closure of its acquisition of a controlling stake in ID Quantique. IonQ also showcased real-world applications, such as a 12% speed improvement in a heart pump simulation using quantum-processed data, and provided a strong financial outlook for the full year 2025.

title: ServiceNow Enhances Its Workflow Data Fabric With New Ecosystem to Power AI agents and Workflows With Real-Time Intelligence
summary: ServiceNow announced new Workflow Data Fabric capabilities, including the Workflow Data Network, a broad ecosystem connecting data platforms, applications, and tools on the ServiceNow AI Platform. This initiative aims to address siloed data challenges in AI adoption by enabling AI agents and workflows to access real-time intelligence from any source through enhanced partnerships and over 100 integrations. ServiceNow also declared its intent to acquire data.world to bolster its data catalog and governance solutions, further strengthening its AI platform.

title: PepsiCo and AWS collaborate to accelerate digital transformation
summary: PepsiCo has announced a strategic, multi-year agreement with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to accelerate its digital transformation. This collaboration focuses on leveraging AWS's infrastructure and services to drive AI innovation, transform supply chain and go-to-market strategies, and create personalized consumer experiences. The partnership involves cloud migration, enhancement of PepsiCo's generative AI platform PepGenX with Amazon Bedrock, and utilizing real-time insights for targeted marketing.

title: PepsiCo Announces Strategic, Multi-year Agreement With Amazon Web Services
summary: PepsiCo has announced a strategic, multi-year agreement with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to accelerate its enterprise-wide digital transformation. This collaboration will leverage AWS's infrastructure and services to drive AI innovation, transform supply chain and go-to-market strategies, and enhance personalized consumer experiences. Both companies emphasize the importance of cloud technology and AI in meeting evolving consumer expectations and achieving scalability.

title: Nutanix Next CEO Keynote: 6 Big Remarks On Google, AWS, Cisco And Pure Storage
summary: During the Nutanix Next 2025 keynote, CEO Rajiv Ramaswami announced significant partnerships and innovations with Google Cloud, AWS, Cisco, Dell Technologies, and Pure Storage. Key highlights include Nutanix's availability on Google Cloud, the new FlashStack solution with Cisco and Pure Storage, and the general availability of Nutanix's cloud platform integrated with Dell PowerFlex. Ramaswami also detailed the refactoring of Nutanix AOS to be fully cloud-native on Amazon's EKS, emphasizing multi-cloud portability and resilience.

title: Banks are keeping credit card rates high even after the CFPB rule they blamed for high APRs was killed
summary: Despite the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) rule, which banks blamed for high credit card APRs, being struck down, major issuers like Synchrony and Bread Financial are maintaining elevated interest rates and fees. These companies had raised rates and added fees last year in anticipation of the CFPB regulation designed to limit late fees. Executives have stated they have no plans to roll back these changes, to the detriment of consumers, especially those who rely on high-interest retail-branded credit cards.

title: Vanguard Total Stock Market Index Fund ETF Shares (VTI) Stock Price Quote Today & Current Price Chart
summary: The Vanguard Total Stock Market Index Fund ETF Shares (VTI) aims to mirror the performance of the overall U.S. stock market by tracking the CRSP US Total Market Index. This ETF, established in 1992, is known for its low costs, broad diversification, and tax efficiency, holding nearly 4,000 constituents across all market capitalizations. As of February 28, 2022, technology and consumer discretionary were its largest sector holdings, with major positions in companies like Apple, Microsoft, and Amazon.

title: Hyperscale Data Surge: What’s Behind It?
summary: Hyperscale Data Inc. (GPUS) stock surged over 53% due to preliminary Q1 revenue exceeding $25M and renewed investor interest. Despite this significant short-term gain, the company faces profitability issues with negative EBIT and EBITDA margins, cautioning investors about long-term stability challenges. The article emphasizes disciplined trading based on actual stock performance rather than speculation.

title: MEGL Shares Climb: Future Growth or Passing Trend?
summary: Magic Empire Global Limited (MEGL) shares recently climbed by 46.61% driven by hedge fund interest, strategic partnerships, insider acquisitions, and AI adoption trends. The article analyzes MEGL's financial snapshot, including $12.78M in revenue and $127.5M cash reserves, alongside volatile stock performance and the potential impact of new developments. It questions whether the surge signifies future growth or a temporary market trend, urging caution for traders.

title: CEO at 33, Tubi's Anjali Sud on success hacks she learned at Amazon, IAC on way to top of Fox streaming
summary: Anjali Sud, CEO of Tubi, was named to the 2025 CNBC Changemakers list and discussed her career path, including her rise to CEO at 33 and her leadership roles at Amazon and IAC. She emphasizes building strategies based on understanding customer needs rather than solely competing with industry giants like Netflix. Sud also highlights the importance of internal debate for innovation, embracing impatience in execution while being patient with vision, and the value of prioritizing sleep for overall success.

title: National Vision Holdings Eyes New Leadership: Will It Soar?
summary: National Vision Holdings Inc. is undergoing a significant leadership change with Alex Wilkes appointed as the new CEO, effective August 1st. This transition, alongside a reported 14.18% stock increase and upcoming Q1 2025 financial results, sparks cautious optimism among investors despite mixed financial metrics such as negative profit margins and a risky debt-to-equity ratio. The market is closely watching how Wilkes's experience from CooperVision and EssilorLuxottica will influence future strategic growth and profitability.

title: Costco managed another month of sales growth in April. But it marks a slowdown from March.
summary: Costco Wholesale Corp. reported that its sales for April rose 7% year-over-year to $21.18 billion, a slowdown compared to the previous month. This growth comes as retailers are adjusting for the timing of the Easter holiday and anticipating the effects of new tariffs. The company also saw a 4.4% increase in same-store sales and a 12.6% rise in e-commerce sales for the four weeks ending May 4th.

title: Vanguard Information Technology Index Fund ETF Shares (VGT) Stock Price Quote Today & Current Price Chart
summary: This article provides the current stock price and chart for the Vanguard Information Technology Index Fund ETF Shares (VGT), which tracks the performance of the MSCI US Investable Market Information Technology Index. It details trading conditions for CFDs on VGT, including spread, margin, and overnight funding adjustments. The fund invests in large, mid-size, and small U.S. companies within the information technology sector.

title: Top Chief Technology Officers to Watch in 2025: Maximus’ Mike Raker
summary: Mike Raker, CTO of Maximus, is highlighted as a top CTO to watch in 2025 for his leadership in AI and customer experience initiatives. Raker has focused on implementing AI solutions for government agencies, such as accelerating application processing for the Department of Veterans Affairs, leading to significant efficiency gains. He is also looking ahead to the "next generation of CX" for federal agencies, emphasizing data utilization and advanced analytics to improve public services.

title: PepsiCo Makes Alliance With AWS to Strengthen Digital Infrastructure
summary: PepsiCo has entered into a multi-year strategic alliance with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to enhance its digital infrastructure across AI, supply chain, and customer experience globally. This collaboration will leverage AWS's cloud services, including Amazon Bedrock for generative AI, to boost PepsiCo's operational efficiencies, digital supply chain capabilities, and personalized customer interactions. Despite this forward-looking move, PepsiCo's shares have recently underperformed due to weaker North American consumer demand, product recalls, geopolitical tensions, and adverse currency rates.

title: Uber investing $100M into WeRide to bring robotaxis to 15 cities
summary: Uber is deepening its partnership with Chinese autonomous vehicle developer WeRide, investing an additional $100 million. This investment aims to expand WeRide's robotaxi technology to 15 new cities over the next five years, primarily outside the U.S. and China. WeRide's services will be integrated into the Uber app, with Uber handling fleet operations and WeRide providing the autonomous driving technology, furthering their goal of making autonomous mobility more accessible globally.

title: Eaton shares tumble as Q3 guidance falls short of expectations
summary: Eaton Corporation plc (NYSE:ETN) reported strong Q2 adjusted EPS and record revenue that beat analyst estimates. However, the company's shares tumbled 6.4% as its Q3 adjusted EPS guidance of $3.01-$3.07 fell short of analyst expectations of $3.10. Despite this, Eaton expects full-year 2025 adjusted EPS to be in line with consensus estimates, driven by strong organic growth and record sales in its Electrical Americas and Aerospace segments.

title: EPAM Systems: Strategic Moves with AWS
summary: EPAM Systems' stock has risen by 13.4% due to strategic partnerships, particularly a deepened collaboration with Amazon Web Services (AWS) focusing on generative AI solutions and workload migration using Amazon Bedrock. Despite positive sentiment, several analysts like Mizuho, HSBC, Stifel, and Scotiabank have lowered price targets for EPAM Systems, citing market uncertainty and macro concerns, while still largely maintaining "Overweight" or "Outperform" ratings. The company's recent financial performance shows consistent revenue growth but mixed profitability indicators, with its strategic alliances, especially with AWS, expected to offset growth tapering concerns.

title: Rigetti Computing, Inc. Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2023 Financial Results
summary: Rigetti Computing, Inc. announced its financial results for the fourth quarter and full year 2023, reporting a net loss of $12.6 million and total revenues of $3.4 million for the quarter, and a net loss of $75.1 million and $12.0 million in revenues for the full year. The company emphasized its strong financial position with $99.9 million in cash and cash equivalents, along with significant business and technology updates including new QPU sales and advancements in its quantum computing architecture with the Ankaa-2 system. Rigetti is focusing on developing higher-performing QPUs and expanding its partnerships for quantum machine learning and HPC integration.

title: EBay launches resale trend report
summary: EBay has released its new "Watchlist" trend report, offering insights into shopper behavior and data within the pre-owned fashion market, drawing from its 134 million users. The report identified Louis Vuitton as the most-purchased designer label and Birkenstock as the fastest-growing brand on the platform in Q1 2025. EBay also announced the appointment of Brie Welch as its resident stylist to identify and comment on trends, further empowering the circular fashion economy.

title: EXEC: Peloton CEO Highlights Four “Objectives” to Drive Growth
summary: Peloton's CEO, Peter Stern, outlined four key objectives to drive growth after the company raised its full-year guidance for 2025. These objectives include enhancing member outcomes through improved products and services, expanding reach to new members and locations, fostering deeper connections among existing members, and streamlining operations for greater efficiency and revenue maximization. The company reported positive Adjusted EBITDA for the fifth consecutive quarter and raised its full-year guidance for various metrics, signaling a strong financial recovery.

title: Here’s Where To Shop All Of Molly-Mae’s ‘Behind It All’ Outfits, Including Her Exact Pair Of Glasses
summary: This article details Molly-Mae Hague's outfits from her docuseries "Molly-Mae: Behind It All," providing shopping links for exact items and similar alternatives. It covers everything from high-street finds to designer pieces, reflecting her "elevated casual vibe." The piece also touches on her personal life shared in the documentary, including her relationship with Tommy Fury, motherhood, and her brand Maebe.

title: IBM Is America’s Worst Tech Company
summary: The article argues that IBM has fallen dramatically from its former prominence as a leading tech company, citing its consistently flat revenue growth and significantly smaller market capitalization compared to competitors like Apple, Amazon, and Microsoft. It highlights IBM's failure to succeed in key tech sectors such as cloud computing and AI, where its market share is negligible. The author concludes that IBM, despite attempts by its CEO to project AI success, is now among America's worst tech companies, especially when compared to its more successful peers.

title: Invesco Global Core Equity Fund Q1 2025 Commentary
summary: The Invesco Global Core Equity Fund's Q1 2025 commentary reflects a shift from post-election optimism to uncertainty, citing a lack of coherent policy direction from President Trump's administration. The fund has consequently built a diversified portfolio of high-quality businesses with strong balance sheets to navigate the current environment. Investors are encouraged to remain open-minded about US policy direction.

title: 13 billion mattress empire to establish offices in Texas
summary: Somnigroup International, the new corporation formed by the acquisition of Houston-based Mattress Firm by Tempur Sealy International, will establish its corporate headquarters in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. This move follows a $4 billion deal that created the $13 billion company. While Tempur Sealy will maintain its Kentucky base and Mattress Firm its Houston operations, Dallas was chosen for the new overarching corporate office, further solidifying North Texas as a growing business hub.

title: How Kroger is looking past its failed plan to merge with Albertsons
summary: Kroger is actively moving past its failed merger with Albertsons by implementing significant internal changes. These include appointing a new CFO, consolidating online operations into a new business unit, expanding private label offerings, and restructuring its 84.51° analytics subsidiary. Despite ongoing legal challenges and the search for a new CEO, the company is refocusing on its core business and strategic initiatives.

title: Beamr Issues Q1-2025 CEO Letter to Shareholders: Experiencing Rising Demand for Our Technology Across Key Verticals
summary: Beamr Imaging Ltd. issued its Q1-2025 CEO Letter to Shareholders, highlighting expanded sales pipelines, growing traction from large-scale prospects, and continued innovation in cloud and product offerings. The company reported a 55% year-over-year revenue increase to $0.63M in Q1 2025 and anticipates significant revenue growth for the full year 2025, driven by market validation and strategic partnerships, including joining the AWS ISV Accelerate program and winning an NAB Show Product of the Year award.

title: Plug Reports First Quarter 2025 Financial Results
summary: Plug Power Inc. announced its financial results for Q1 2025, reporting increased revenue of $133.7 million and a substantial improvement in gross margin loss. The company highlighted key operational milestones including the commissioning of a hydrogen liquefaction plant in Louisiana, significant growth in its electrolyzer business, and improved cash flow, reducing net cash used in operating and investing activities by nearly half compared to Q1 2024. These developments, along with strategic financing and debt reduction, position Plug for continued commercial growth and improved profitability, targeting a positive impact on the global hydrogen economy.

title: Viasat Announces Appointments of Bill LaPlante and Michael Paull to Its Board of Directors
summary: Viasat, Inc. announced the appointments of Dr. William “Bill” LaPlante and Michael Paull to its Board of Directors, effective immediately. Dr. LaPlante brings extensive defense and national security experience, while Mr. Paull offers proven leadership in the direct-to-consumer digital streaming industry. Concurrently, James “Jim” Bridenstine resigned from the Board, and Viasat will continue to engage his services through his firm, The Artemis Group.

title: 3 Stocks to Sell and 3 Stocks to Buy Instead
summary: Morningstar's Chief US Market Strategist, Dave Sekera, discusses the market's reaction to potential trade breakthroughs between the US and China, the Fed's decision to hold rates, and upcoming economic data. He provides insights on several company earnings, identifies three stocks to sell (Philip Morris International, Exelon, American Water Works) due to being overvalued, and three stocks to buy (Amazon, Ingersoll Rand, Marvell Technology) that are currently undervalued according to Morningstar's analysis. Sekera also advises investors to maintain a market-weight position, favoring value and small-cap stocks, and to prepare for potential market volatility.

title: Will 2025 Be the Year of Diversification in Equities?
summary: As geopolitical tensions, trade policy shifts, and inflation remain high, 2025 is seen as a crucial year for portfolio diversification. The article highlights four key areas for investors to consider: diversifying within U.S. equities, exploring less-correlated international markets like Japan, utilizing broad commodity indices, and investing in the growing cryptocurrency ecosystem as regulatory frameworks evolve. This comprehensive approach aims to manage risk and address the dominance of U.S. equities and mega-cap concentration.

title: The Gig Trap: Algorithmic, Wage and Labor Exploitation in Platform Work in the US | HRW
summary: This Human Rights Watch report details how digital labor platforms in the US exploit workers through algorithmic management, wage opacity, and misclassification as independent contractors, denying them crucial labor protections and social security benefits. The report, based on extensive interviews and surveys with gig workers in states like Texas, reveals widespread financial insecurity, low wages—often below minimum wage after expenses—and vulnerability to arbitrary deactivations and on-the-job hazards. It calls for urgent regulatory reforms, including proper employment classification using the "ABC test," algorithmic fairness, guaranteed living wages, adequate social protection, and strengthened worker bargaining power to ensure platform workers' human rights are upheld.

title: After Earnings, Is Palantir Stock a Buy, a Sell, or Fairly Valued?
summary: Morningstar maintains a narrow moat rating on Palantir Technologies and has raised its fair value estimate to $100 per share following strong Q1 earnings, driven by increased demand from government and commercial customers. Despite impressive revenue growth and profitability, the stock trades at a significant premium, leading to a "fairly valued" assessment. Investors are advised that while the company shows strong performance, its very high uncertainty rating and premium valuation temper expectations for substantial upside unless the stock drops to the $80 level.

title: Amazon and FedEx reach delivery deal following pullback by UPS
summary: Amazon and FedEx have re-established a package delivery agreement following Amazon's decision to significantly reduce shipments handled by UPS. This new deal will see FedEx transporting select Amazon packages, including large items, with a focus on heavier weights and all US ZIP codes. FedEx anticipates this partnership will be beneficial and accretive to its domestic market yield, though Amazon specifies it's not meant to replace UPS.

title: PepsiCo signs multi-year contract with AWS
summary: PepsiCo has entered into a multi-year agreement with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to migrate its applications and workloads to AWS' cloud platform, aligning with its "cloud-first" strategy. This collaboration aims to enhance agility, intelligence, and scalability across PepsiCo's global operations, including integrating generative AI with Amazon Bedrock and exploring predictive maintenance in its supply chain. The move follows previous cloud migrations with Microsoft Azure and highlights the ongoing trend of major corporations adopting cloud solutions.

title: The Rise and Fall, and Rise Again, of Sea Ltd
summary: Sea Ltd, parent company of Shopee, has staged a remarkable turnaround after a significant stock decline from $350 in 2021 to $40 in 2022. The company achieved its best financial year in 2024, reporting $448 million in net income and $16.8 billion in revenue, driven by growth in its e-commerce and digital finance segments. While its gaming division, Garena, remains profitable, Sea is strategically shifting focus towards its increasingly robust e-commerce and digital finance operations, demonstrating a path toward stable profitability.

title: Neil Sutton departs NCR Voyix to take on Chief Revenue Officer role at vision AI specialist Everseen
summary: Neil Sutton has left NCR Voyix to become the Chief Revenue Officer at Everseen, a company specializing in visual AI solutions for retailers. Sutton expressed his admiration for Everseen's founder and CEO, Alan O'Herlihy, and highlighted Everseen's position as a market leader in vision AI, trusted by top global retailers to reduce shrink and improve operations. The article also touches upon the RTIH AI in Retail Awards, which are open for entries and aim to celebrate innovation in AI within the retail sector.

title: Weatherford Announces a Strategic Agreement with Amazon Web
summary: Weatherford International has partnered with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to enhance its digital capabilities and drive innovation in the energy sector. Weatherford will migrate and modernize its software and hardware suite to AWS as its preferred cloud provider, including its Modern Edge Platform and Unified Data Model. This collaboration aims to improve operational efficiency, facilitate data-driven decision-making, and expand the WFRD Software Launchpad for customers.

title: What Lessons Can Investors Learn From Cathie Wood's Ark Invest's Aggressive Investment Philosophy?
summary: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest focuses on aggressive investments in cutting-edge technologies like blockchain, AI, and robotics, aiming for high rewards despite high risks. While Ark has had notable successes with early investments in Bitcoin, Tesla, and Nvidia, its flagship Ark Innovation ETF has seen significant downturns and negative returns more recently. The article suggests that while innovation-focused investing can yield huge gains, implementing an innovation-only portfolio carries substantial risk, emphasizing the difficulty of consistently picking winning companies.

title: Launch of Innovative ADAMS™ Plant-Based, EPA-Approved Flea and Tick Spray Marks 50 Years of Trusted Pet Care
summary: ADAMS™ flea and tick products are celebrating their 50th anniversary with the launch of an innovative new product, ADAMS™ Botanicals Flea & Tick Pet & Home Spray. This plant-based, EPA-approved spray combines effective pest protection with gentler ingredients for use on pets and household surfaces. In celebration of National Pet Month and their anniversary, ADAMS™ is partnering with Best Friends Animal Society to donate $35,000 toward saving homeless pets.

title: If You Invested $10K In Walt Disney Stock 10 Years Ago, How Much Would You Have Now?
summary: An investor who put $10,000 into Walt Disney stock ten years ago would now have $10,941, representing a 9.41% total return from stock appreciation and dividends. This return significantly lags the S&P 500's 231% total return over the same period. Despite past performance, analysts project a "Buy" rating for Disney with a potential upside of over 13%, driven by strong Q2 2025 earnings and performance in its Entertainment and Experiences segments.

title: AI-Based US Stock Trading Below $35 to Watch for Explosive Returns
summary: The article highlights DigitalOcean Holdings Inc. (NYSE: DOCN) as an attractive AI-based US stock, especially for small and medium businesses due to its affordable cloud computing and AI services. Despite a significant drop from its all-time high, the company is expanding its market share at its current trading price of $31, suggesting potential for substantial growth and profits for investors. Investing in DOCN now, while it's trading below $35, could lead to explosive returns as the company continues to penetrate the SMB market.

title: Marsh McLennan gears up for massive AWS migration
summary: Marsh McLennan, a 150-year-old professional services firm, is undertaking a multiyear initiative to migrate the majority of its on-premises infrastructure to Amazon Web Services (AWS). This move aims to bolster security, boost AI capabilities, and streamline operations across its four divisions. The company plans a phased "lift-and-shift" approach for the migration, prioritizing automation, and will continue to run some workloads on-premises for compliance reasons while focusing on cloud skills development and leveraging AWS to enhance its existing generative AI tools.

title: As Egg Prices Soar, Amazon and Top Investors Profit
summary: As avian flu outbreaks led to soaring egg prices, major U.S. egg producers Vital Farms and Cal-Maine, along with their top institutional investors including BlackRock, Vanguard, and Amazon, saw significant increases in profits and stock values. Consumers faced financial strain due to high prices, while these companies expanded operations and benefited from the market conditions. The situation has prompted questions about corporate consolidation and potential price gouging, with the Department of Justice opening an investigation into Cal-Maine.

title: Everus Construction Group’s Stock Surges Amid Major Acquisition Announcement
summary: Everus Construction Group Inc.’s (ECG) stock has surged by 23.45% following a major acquisition in the renewable energy sector and a strong earnings report. The company reported revenues crossing $2.85 billion and a high pre-tax profit margin, with analysts anticipating continued growth. ECG's strategic expansion into foreign markets and adoption of eco-friendly practices are enhancing its long-term potential and investor confidence.

title: Samsung makes biggest acquisition in 8 years with $1.7b FlaktGroup deal
summary: Samsung Electronics is set to acquire German HVAC solutions provider FlaktGroup for $1.7 billion, marking its largest acquisition in eight years. The deal aims to bolster Samsung's HVAC business and leadership in the global market, particularly in the rapidly growing data center cooling segment. This move, along with other recent acquisitions, highlights Samsung's strategy to expand its competitive edge through mergers and acquisitions.

title: Here's Why Amazon.com, Inc.'s (NASDAQ:AMZN) CEO May Deserve A Raise
summary: Amazon.com, Inc.'s CEO Andy Jassy received a total annual compensation of US$1.6m in 2024, significantly below the industry median for similar companies, reflecting a relatively modest remuneration despite the company's strong performance. Over the past three years, Amazon has seen an 83% total shareholder return and a 43% annual EPS growth. Given these impressive results and Jassy's substantial shareholdings in the company, shareholders are likely satisfied, and a discussion about his compensation at the upcoming AGM may not be a primary focus.

title: Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) and HUMAIN to Invest $5B+ in Saudi Arabia’s AI Zone Development
summary: Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) and HUMAIN, a newly established AI startup in Saudi Arabia, plan to jointly invest over $5 billion to develop an "AI Zone" in the country. This initiative is part of a broader shift in U.S. policy under the Trump administration, which aims to deepen tech ties with Middle Eastern partners by providing access to advanced AI chips and technology, contrasting with previous restrictions. The AI Zone will feature AWS AI infrastructure, UltraCluster networks, and services to position Saudi Arabia as a leading AI hub, specifically supporting developments in Large Language Models, including Arabic variants.

title: Top 20 Discount Stores in the World in 2026
summary: This article lists the top 20 discount stores globally for 2026, offering consumers opportunities to save money on various products. The list includes major retailers like Amazon, Walmart, and Costco, alongside specialized discount chains such as T.J. Maxx and Dollar Tree. Each entry provides a brief overview of the company, its market capitalization, and what makes it popular among budget-conscious shoppers.

title: Jim Cramer Says He’s ‘Kind of Wary’ of Maplebear Inc. (CART)
summary: Jim Cramer expressed wariness regarding Maplebear Inc. (CART), the parent company of Instacart, despite its strong quarterly report. His concern stemmed from the intense competition in the grocery delivery space, particularly from Amazon. However, subsequent performance showed his wariness was unfounded, as the stock rose 27.51% over the following twelve months.

title: Things To Be Wary Of When Buying Netflix Stock
summary: Netflix stock has seen a significant surge, rising 25% this year to around $1,100 per share, driven by strong financial performance, subscriber growth from ad-supported plans, and price increases. Despite strong fundamentals in growth, profitability, and financial stability, the stock is considered volatile and expensive with high valuation ratios compared to the S&P 500, making it a tricky investment. The article advises caution due to its high valuation and sensitivity to adverse events, even though its operational performance and financial health are robust.

title: Box expands its toolbox with more AI agents for search, deep research and data extraction
summary: Box Inc. is expanding its artificial intelligence capabilities by launching new AI agents for search, deep research, and data extraction, along with a Box AI Agent for Microsoft 365 Copilot. These new agents aim to automate various tasks for users and integrate Box content seamlessly into Microsoft applications. Box emphasizes its vision of an "intelligent content management platform" and highlights the need for clean data architecture to maximize AI benefits.

title: 'He Won't Sell One Toy In The United States,' Says Donald Trump Suggesting A 100% Tariff On Mattel Which He Seemed To Mistake For A Country
summary: Donald Trump has reiterated his aggressive stance on tariffs, proposing a 100% tariff on Mattel Inc. while seemingly mistaking the company for a country. This comes as Mattel aims to diversify its supply chain away from China, a move Trump criticized, advocating instead for U.S.-based manufacturing. The potential tariffs could lead to higher toy prices and a significant shortage, especially during the holiday season.

title: Netflix Is Turning Into an Advertising Company
summary: Netflix, once a pioneer of ad-free streaming, is rapidly transforming into an advertising company. Its ad-supported tier now boasts 94 million global monthly active users and is its fastest-growing segment. The company is actively developing new ad formats, including AI-powered contextual ads, to compete directly with major digital advertising players like Google, Meta, and Amazon, signaling a significant shift in its business model.

title: NICE Ltd (NICE) Q1 2025 Earnings Call Highlights: Strong Cloud Growth and Strategic ...
summary: NICE Ltd (NICE) reported a strong Q1 2025 with total revenue up 6% to $700 million and cloud revenue increasing 12% to $527 million, despite some seasonal and service revenue declines. The company highlighted strategic partnerships with ServiceNow and AWS, a record share repurchase, and a positive outlook for AI-driven growth. Challenges include deployment delays for large enterprise solutions and a slight decline in cloud gross margin due to investments.

title: Norma Partners with Rigetti to Launch 84-Qubit Quantum Cloud Service in South Korea
summary: Norma Inc. has partnered with Rigetti Computing to launch an 84-qubit quantum cloud service in South Korea, integrating Rigetti's hardware with Norma's Q Platform. This collaboration aims to provide cloud-based quantum program development and execution, expanding access to quantum computing in South Korea. Norma's strategy involves acting as a middleware provider, leveraging international hardware partnerships to support the nation's growing quantum ecosystem.

title: Prologis Stock: The Warehouse King With A 3.8% Yield And Room To Run (NYSE:PLD)
summary: Prologis (PLD) presents a strong buy-on-weakness opportunity, currently trading 15% below its intrinsic value and offering an attractive 3.8% dividend yield. The company demonstrates robust operational performance with high occupancy rates, strong tenant retention, and impressive rent growth despite macroeconomicchallenges. title: How to Start an Etsy Shop in 10 Easy Steps
summary: This article provides a step-by-step guide on how to open an Etsy shop and begin selling handmade crafts or vintage items online. It covers everything from setting up an account and choosing a shop name to photographing products, adding listings, selecting payment preferences, and understanding Etsy seller fees. The guide emphasizes the ease of setting up an online storefront on Etsy for new sellers.

title: U.S. Defense and AI Companies Poised to Dominate Middle East Spending Wave
summary: The article discusses how U.S. defense and AI companies are set to benefit significantly from a new wave of spending in the Middle East, particularly spurred by President Trump's recent diplomatic efforts. Aviation also plays a crucial role with a large deal between Boeing and Qatar Airways, all against a backdrop of rising global military spending.

title: UBER vs. GRAB: Which Ride-Hailing Stock is a Stronger Play Now?
summary: This article compares Uber (UBER) and Grab (GRAB) as investment opportunities in the ride-hailing sector, highlighting their distinct geographical focuses and business models. Uber, a global player with diversification into food delivery and freight, demonstrates strong financial performance and a shareholder-friendly approach. Grab, dominant in Southeast Asia with an "everyday everything app" strategy, shows growth in its on-demand GMV but faces challenges from economic uncertainties and intense competition, leading the analysis to conclude Uber is currently the better pick despite both holding a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

title: Laird Superfood expands functional product range with six new mushroom powders
summary: Laird Superfood has launched six new organic mushroom powders, expanding its functional product range. These include two blends, Calm & Relaxation and Focus & Memory, which combine mushrooms with botanical ingredients for specific wellbeing benefits. Additionally, four individual organic mushroom powders (lion’s mane, reishi, turkey tail, and oyster) have been introduced, all organic, US-grown, and free from fillers, and will be available online and in select US retail locations.

title: Stock Of The Day Quanta Services Near Buy Point As Energy Appetite Expands Backlog
summary: Quanta Services is highlighted as the Stock Of The Day, nearing a buy point with a handle valid after Tuesday at $348.42. The company's backlog is expanding significantly due to the AI-spurred demand for power projects, leading to a strong Composite Rating of 97/99. Several heavy construction stocks, including Quanta Services, are seeing increased activity and approaching buy zones amidst this energy appetite.

title: Meta to buy 200 MW of wind energy from TransAlta as it expands footprint
summary: Meta has signed a long-term agreement to purchase 200 MW of wind energy and environmental attributes from TransAlta's Horizon Hill Wind Power Project in Oklahoma. This deal supports Meta's goal of powering global operations solely with wind and solar energy as its footprint expands. The project, expected to cost between US$290 million and US$310 million, contributes to TransAlta's goal of adding 2 GW of renewables by 2025.

title: The 13 Best Hot Dogs We’ve Ever Tasted
summary: This article compiles a list of the 13 best hot dogs available at the grocery store, based on four taste tests conducted by Sporked. The criteria for judgment included snap, flavor, and size, ensuring the dogs fit standard buns comfortably. The top recommendations range from classic beef franks to gourmet options, as well as the best cocktail wieners and stuffed hot dogs.

title: Edible Garden Stock Skyrockets on Big News
summary: Edible Garden AG Incorporated (NASDAQ: EDBL) stock surged by over 55% following promising developments including the acquisition of NaturalShrimp Farms’ assets for $12M, product expansion into sports nutrition via Amazon, and increased distribution with Stop & Shop. Despite a net income loss and revenue dip, the company's strategic shift toward higher-margin products and sustainable initiatives, coupled with reduced expenses, signals a positive future outlook. Investors are optimistic about the company's growth potential through strategic acquisitions and e-commerce expansion.

title: GCL Global Holdings Ltd Soars with Key Strategic Moves
summary: GCL Global Holdings Ltd (NASDAQ: GCL) saw its stock surge by 14.35% due to advancements in renewable energy and strategic partnerships with regional tech firms. The company's expansion into renewable energy and an executive leadership overhaul signal a significant shift in its long-term strategy, aiming to revamp operating efficiencies and drive future growth. Analysts predict a sturdy uptick in GCL's stock price, noting the company's commitment to leveraging technological advancements and meticulous execution while maintaining a stable debt situation.

title: Modine records highest sales in company history, supported by data center demand
summary: Modine, a thermal management technology manufacturer, reported its highest sales and profitability for the third consecutive year in fiscal 2025, with net sales growing 7% to $2.6 billion and net earnings increasing 14% to $185.5 million. This record performance was largely driven by its data center business, prompting a $38 million investment to expand production capacity in Grenada, Mississippi. The company expects continued strong growth in its Climate Solutions segment, particularly for data centers, and has developed relationships with five hyperscalers.

title: Willard Retail takes over retail leasing at Potomac Yard shopping center
summary: Willard Retail has been selected to manage the retail leasing for Potomac Yard Center, a large 500,000-square-foot shopping center in Washington D.C. The center's anchor tenants include Target, Best Buy, and Amazon Fresh. This new appointment signifies a change in leasing agents for the prominent retail space.

title: Big Mag 7 Rally Pays Off for QBIG
summary: The Invesco Top QQQ ETF (QBIG), holding Magnificent Seven stocks and Broadcom, has seen a 16% gain in the month ending May 15, outperforming the S&P 500 Growth Index. This rebound is attributed to clearer international trade policy and potential AI advancements, despite the ETF still being in the red year-to-date. A recent thaw in U.S./China trade relations also bodes well for QBIG’s holdings.

title: Arqit Quantum Inc. Announces Financial Results for First Half of Fiscal Year 2025
summary: Arqit Quantum Inc. announced its financial results for the first half of fiscal year 2025, reporting $67,000 in revenue. This figure was adversely affected by end customer delays, though the company expects a previously signed multi-year government contract to generate seven figures in annual recurring revenue. Arqit also highlighted significant recent developments, including new contracts with the U.S. DoD and a Tier 1 network operator, and collaborations with Intel on quantum-safe solutions.

title: Alert the Group Chat: Lands' End Boat Totes Are 50% Off for Memorial Day Weekend
summary: Lands' End is offering a 50% discount on their boat totes and other items for Memorial Day Weekend, with an additional $10 off most totes using code CAMO. This sale allows customers to purchase the popular and versatile canvas totes, which are praised for their functionality and customization options, at a significant markdown. The author highlights the appeal of these totes for a "coastal grandma" aesthetic.

title: The IT wingspan of JPMorgan Chase & Co.
summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. (JPMC), the largest US bank, employs a complex hybrid IT infrastructure strategy balancing enterprise data centers with multi-cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) for resilience and leading-edge capabilities. Infrastructure CIO Darrin Alves highlights JPMC's commitment to technology, significant investments, and plans to consolidate its global data center estate from 32 to 17 facilities while rigorously applying legal, security, and resiliency criteria before cost optimization. The bank is also investing in AI and quantum computing research, leveraging cloud for generative AI experimentation, and utilizing mainframes for critical systems.

title: Dolby Atmos now available across the entire Mercedes fleet, but there’s a catch
summary: Mercedes-Benz has expanded the availability of Dolby Atmos across its entire car fleet, moving beyond its previous restriction to top-tier models like the S-Class and Maybach. To experience Dolby Atmos, customers must opt for an upgraded Burmester sound system, which often comes as part of a premium package. This integration offers an immersive audio experience, significantly enhancing in-car music and even audiobooks from sources like Apple Music, Amazon Music, Tidal, and Audible.

title: The Surging Value of the Magnificent 7 Versus the S&P 500 (2014-2024)
summary: From 2014 to 2024, the S&P 500 saw over 220% returns, with the "Magnificent 7" (Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft, Nvidia, Tesla) driving a significant portion of this growth. These tech giants now constitute over one-third of the S&P 500, raising concentration risk concerns. The Tema S&P 500 Historical Weight ETF (DSPY) offers an alternative by adjusting company weights to their 35-year historical averages for a more balanced investment approach.

title: Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) Faces Lawsuit Over Claims it Sold Contaminated Rice
summary: Amazon.com, Inc. is being sued by consumers claiming the company sold various rice products tainted with arsenic and other heavy metals. The proposed class action targets 18 rice varieties, including Ben's Original and Whole Foods' 365, alleging that Amazon sold these products with dangerously high levels of heavy metals without warning, especially concerning for children. This lawsuit follows a study revealing widespread heavy metal contamination in rice across the US, and the plaintiffs are seeking at least $5 million in damages.

title: Amazon pauses plan to build data center near Becker
summary: Amazon has paused its plans to build a large data center near Xcel Energy's Sherco site in Becker, Minnesota. This decision comes amidst discussions in the Minnesota Legislature to remove a sales tax exemption on electricity used by data centers, a move opposed by Republicans but supported by Governor Tim Walz to balance the state's budget. Xcel Energy confirmed Amazon's pause, stating it was due to factors independent of their electricity readiness, while Amazon emphasized its continuous evaluation of new locations based on customer demand.

title: Gannett’s SWOT analysis: digital growth amid print decline shapes stock outlook
summary: Gannett, the largest U.S. newspaper publisher, is navigating a challenging media landscape by transitioning from print to digital, as detailed in an InvestingPro SWOT analysis. While facing overall revenue decline and difficulties in its Digital Marketing Solutions (DMS) segment, the company shows strength in its growing digital audience, subscriptions, cost discipline, and strategic AI partnerships. Future success hinges on accelerating digital revenue growth and managing debt as asset sale opportunities diminish.

title: The Trade Desk vs. Criteo: Which Ad Tech Stock is the Better Buy Now?
summary: This article compares two ad tech companies, The Trade Desk (TTD) and Criteo (CRTO), to determine which is a better investment. While TTD is gaining from strong revenue growth in the first quarter of 2025, it faces challenges from macroeconomic uncertainties, intense competition, and regulatory scrutiny. Criteo, on the other hand, is transitioning towards high-growth areas like Retail Media with its AI-driven platform and direct retailer access, and is considered the smarter pick due to its stronger valuation and focus on partnerships.

title: Surging Data Center Growth to Help Lower Energy Costs for PG&E Customers
summary: PG&E anticipates that the significant growth in data center electricity demand, projected to reach 8.7 GW over the next decade, will actually help lower energy costs for its existing customers. The company estimates that for every 1 GW of new data center demand, residential monthly electric bills could decrease by 1-2% due to better utilization of existing infrastructure and spreading costs over more consumption. PG&E is actively working on numerous data center projects, particularly in Silicon Valley and the Bay Area, and is conducting further studies across California to accommodate future growth and integrate these large loads efficiently.

title: Q1 results top expectations at Macy’s Inc.
summary: Macy's Inc. surpassed its guidance for both revenue and earnings per share in the first quarter, despite ongoing struggles in its full-line stores and a decline in net sales. The company attributed some sales loss to store closures and noted better performance in its soft home and big-ticket home departments, as well as its Bloomingdale's and Backstage formats. However, Macy's cut its guidance due to tariff impacts and continued cautious consumer spending.

title: Nvidia delivers another earnings and revenue beat on rampant data center growth
summary: Nvidia's shares rose almost 5% after reporting better-than-expected earnings and revenue for the first quarter, driven by a 73% year-over-year growth in its data center business. Despite missing guidance due to U.S. export restrictions on advanced chips to China, the company's strong performance in AI infrastructure and other sectors, including gaming and automotive, reassured investors. CEO Jensen Huang acknowledged the closure of the Chinese AI chip market for U.S. industry but emphasized the overwhelming global demand for Nvidia's AI solutions.

title: The only analyst on Wall Street who has a 'sell' on Nvidia says the AI chipmaker's great run is over
summary: An analyst from Seaport Research Partners, Jay Goldberg, is the sole analyst on Wall Street with a "sell" rating on Nvidia, believing the AI chipmaker's growth is plateauing. Goldberg cites supply chain limitations from TSMC and volatile trade policies as significant headwinds, particularly after a warning about a potential $5.5 billion writedown due to export license requirements for China. While other analysts remain positive, Goldberg has set a $100 price target, suggesting Broadcom as a better semiconductor investment due to its role in helping hyperscalers develop alternatives to Nvidia's chips.

title: How Restaurants Can Move from AI Hype to Real Results
summary: This article discusses how restaurants can move from the hype of AI to achieving tangible results. It highlights the challenges companies face with disjointed systems and bad data in AI implementation and emphasizes the importance of data quality and understanding the specific problems AI needs to solve. Examples from AWS and Yum! Brands illustrate successful AI applications in boosting productivity, managing operations, and enhancing customer engagement.

title: Anurag Mathur joins Gannett as VP of enterprise and distributed partnerships
summary: Gannett Co., Inc. has announced the appointment of Anurag Mathur as Vice President of Enterprise and Distributed Partnerships. Mathur will be responsible for syndication, content licensing, philanthropic partnerships, and new business development, including in artificial intelligence, reporting to Caroline Harris, SVP of content monetization. He brings nearly 25 years of experience from companies like Amazon, AT&T, and ESPN, and aims to elevate Gannett's content portfolio and drive sustainable revenue streams through new partnerships.

title: State utility officials approve AEP Ohio's building onsite energy generators at two data centers
summary: Ohio utility regulators have approved AEP Ohio's plan to install onsite energy generators at two large data centers belonging to Amazon Web Services and Cologix. This decision aims to provide a secondary power source for the expanding data centers without drawing further from the grid, addressing concerns about increasing energy demand versus available supply. The systems will utilize solid oxide fuel cells and natural gas, with costs borne solely by AWS and Cologix, ensuring other AEP Ohio customers do not incur these expenses.

title: A envergadura de TI do JPMorgan Chase & Co.
summary: Darrin Alves, CIO de plataformas de infraestrutura do JPMorgan Chase & Co. (JPMC), detalha a estratégia de TI do banco, que combina data centers corporativos robustos com uma abordagem multinuvem e híbrida. A empresa, um gigante bancário, visa resiliência e eficiência, tendo superado a meta de mover uma grande porcentagem de seus dados e aplicações para a nuvem. Apesar dos investimentos significativos em tecnologia, o JPMC mantém e otimiza seus data centers on-premise, priorizando segurança e conformidade regulatória.

title: After Earnings, Is Target Stock a Buy, a Sell, or Fairly Valued?
summary: Target's first-quarter earnings showed a revenue decline of 3.0% and a 36.0% drop in adjusted EPS, leading Morningstar to lower its fair value estimate to $123 per share from $135. The company faces significant challenges from intense competition, deteriorating consumer confidence, and potential tariffs, which analysts believe contribute to its undervalued stock. Despite these headwinds, Morningstar rates Target as 4 stars, indicating an undervalued stock, but warns of its ambiguous market position and lack of an economic moat.

title: Analyst Sees ‘Wait-and-See’ for Marvell Technology, Inc. (MRVL) as EPS Drops and Competitors Loom
summary: Redburn Atlantic initiated coverage on Marvell Technology, Inc. (MRVL) with a "Neutral" rating and a $67 price target, citing concerns about its potential involvement in future Amazon Web Services (AWS) Trainium chips. Competitors like Alchip or AWS's Annapurna Labs might take a larger share of AWS's accelerated ASICs work, impacting Marvell. Despite a nearly 50% stock price decline in 2025 and a 16% reduction in three-year forward GAAP EPS, analysts project Marvell to return to profitability in FY2026 with an estimated EPS of $2.83, leading to a "wait-and-see" approach for investors.

title: Sea Limited's (NYSE:SE) Stock Is Going Strong: Have Financials A Role To Play?
summary: Sea Limited's stock has seen a significant increase of 30% recently. This article investigates whether the company's financials, particularly its Return on Equity (ROE), are contributing to this strong performance. Although Sea's ROE of 9.7% is below the industry average, the company has managed impressive net income growth of 41% over the past five years, likely due to substantial reinvestment of profits given its low payout ratio.

title: Talkspace Strikes Deal with Amazon Pharmacy, Expanding Medication Access
summary: Talkspace has partnered with Amazon Pharmacy, making it the first behavioral health provider to integrate with the retail giant's pharmaceutical offerings. This collaboration simplifies medication management for Talkspace providers by allowing them to send prescriptions directly to Amazon Pharmacy with one click and aims to improve medication adherence and access to care for mental health patients. The partnership builds on an earlier arrangement with Amazon Health Services and is expected to drive Talkspace's growth by increasing awareness and facilitating comprehensive care.

title: Bernstein reiterates UPS stock Outperform with $133 target
summary: Bernstein analysts reiterated an Outperform rating and a $133 price target for UPS, despite the stock trading near its 52-week low. CEO Carol Tomé outlined strategic initiatives, including volume rationalization with Amazon and cost reductions, aiming to rebuild investor confidence. Other analysts, including HSBC and Stifel, have adjusted their ratings and price targets for UPS, reflecting mixed sentiments amidst ongoing strategic adjustments and external economic factors.

title: Talkspace Integrates With Amazon Pharmacy To Streamline Psychiatric Medication Fulfillment
summary: Talkspace Inc. has announced a partnership with Amazon Pharmacy, becoming the first behavioral health provider to directly integrate with the service for psychiatric medication management. This collaboration will allow Talkspace psychiatric providers to send prescriptions directly to Amazon Pharmacy, offering patients benefits like free home delivery, refill reminders, and access to affordable medications through Amazon's RxPass program. The integration aims to reduce barriers to care, improving medication adherence and providing a comprehensive digital care experience.

title: Elastic’s full-year revenue outlook misses expectations amid slowing growth
summary: Elastic N.V. shares dropped over 12% after the company's full-year revenue outlook fell short of analyst expectations, despite reporting solid results for its fiscal 2025 fourth quarter. The company announced adjusted earnings per share of 47 cents on revenue of $388 million, both surpassing analyst predictions, while cloud revenue grew 23% year-over-year. Elastic's fiscal year 2026 full-year revenue outlook of $1.655 billion to $1.67 billion missed the expected $1.69 billion.

summary: As summer approaches, Traeger has launched a significant sale on five of its top grills, offering discounts of up to 22% which translate to savings up to $250. summary: Salesforce reported strong fiscal first-quarter results, exceeding guidance with 8% revenue growth to $9.83 billion, primarily driven by Data Cloud and Agentforce. Agentforce, generating $100 million in ARR, continues to build momentum, making Salesforce shares attractive.

title: What’s Happening With IONQ Stock?
summary: IONQ stock has surged 400% in the last year, reflecting growing interest in quantum computing, despite the technology still being in a developmental stage. summary: This article reviews the top pellet smoker grills, identifying the Camp Chef Woodwind Pro 24 as the best overall for its precision and robust smoke flavor. title: Are Investors Undervaluing Maplebear Inc. (NASDAQ:CART) By 34%?
summary: Simply Wall St estimates Maplebear Inc.
